messages:
jia: Quick FYI I ran a bring-up for harrier-embed-v1 on staging. Baseline fp32 vs naive int8. Small but consistent recall@10 drop.

sam: numbers?

jia: fp32 recall@10=0.71, int8=0.67. recall@1=0.39 vs 0.36. silhouette down ~0.03.

noah: Do we have breakdown by query length and language?

jia: Ran breakdown: short queries (<5 toks) hit worst: recall10 delta -0.06. Multilang tail also worse.

evals-bot: autotag: quant_regression; recall-delta@10=-0.04; flag=needs_calib

sam: Try per-channel int8 and a quick qAT with 500 calibration samples. Also run paraphrase synthetic check.

jia: Started jobs job_70011 (per-channel) and job_70012 (qAT-500).

ops-bot: job_70011 finished. Artifacts: /artifacts/job_70011/harrier-perchannel.csv

jia: Per-channel results: recall10 delta -0.01; silhouette delta -0.008. Paraphrase F1 drop reduced from 2.5% -> 0.4%.

sam: Great. Action: recommend per-channel quant profile for harrier-v1 and note short-query sensitivity in model card. Open PR with artifacts.

noah: Agreed. If infra doesn't support per-channel, fallback to qAT profile.

jia: Will do. Linking artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/harrier/bringup/
